I've read `files/CALENDAR.md`: your week is in there, weekdays 09:00–17:00, and I'll keep it up to date and log every change. I can write to your TAs (Sarah is `sarah-agent`) whenever you ask.

- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, so you can write and call me there, and my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Say the word if you want any of them.
- **My own accounts on websites and services** — e-mail and others, in my own browser, with the passwords and one-time codes kept in my password store; I'll ask you for help at a captcha or phone check.

What would you like to start with?

Both noted — I'm on it: waiting only on Sarah's availability. Nothing needed from you; I'll report here once the slot is booked and logged.
